reviews.text: Excellent care, reasonable prices. Their in-house PetCare programme is very good value

Have been a client of this practice for several years and I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Attended for routine vaccinations. I was a few minutes early. The receptionist greeted me and my greyhound by name. My appointment was on time, vet Emma gave her a thorough once over before administering protection.
I would wholeheartedly recommend the Pal For Life scheme operated by Orchard Vets; it provides reassurance should my pet become ill out of hours and helps keep prices very reasonable.

Very unprofessional - i wanted to change my vets & they got me to transfer all my personal details and yorkie's records to call me back to tell me there's no spaces available at this point for new clients.  It's questionable that they can't treat humans civil  - how could they treat animals with respect.
This left me in difficult predicament as the vets i changed from they wouldn't offer me an appointment as I had officially left their services & neither would Orchard vet's Harbourn and yet my Yorkie had an eye ulcer that needed urgent professional care.

We have been using the Harborne branch for more than 25 years for all of our family pets. The vet who saw our elderly cat this week for his yearly vaccinations was kind and caring, taking time to give us relevant information about additional health concerns identified. Extra tests were needed, these are covered within the pet plan which we subscribe to monthly. Over the years this has provided great peace of mind and I think it is good value overall. We have always been very happy with the service our pets have received which is why we have continued to use them.
Excellent service, all treatment given to our dog Bella has been first class. Always helpful always friendly,  their petplan give ultimate peace of mind and is excellent value for money.
Very friendly staff many of whom remember us even though it could have been a while between visits, only negative about Harborne branch is its not very disabled user friendly to access the building.
Brilliant vets like family very friendly

Great veterinary centre. Staff is knowledgeable, friendly, accommodating and listen to your concerns. They have pet for life insurance scheme that is a bit expensive but it is a load of your mind when issues arise with your furbaby.

Friendly helpful staff , any queries are dealt with promptly. The vet is knowledgeable and clearly explains what the problem may be and how they propose treatment. Orchard is a local independent group with three practices so while not cheap they give good value compared to some of the larger chains. Overall very pleased

New puppy Casper, new vets for our future care, been a while since being here, very quiet and stress free for our boy and us, first injections done, worming and flea treatment, 12month injection visit ,Casper is very unsure about stranger's but was handled very caringly by the vet with treats and talking to him, thank you.
Lovely team
Brilliant staff and a very good pet plan scheme
Great vets. Very friendly.
Thank you for the review

I use the cattery here. Whilst my cat wouldn't be happy anywhere (he's old and grumpy), he comes back healthy and clearly looked after. The only thing  I would like is the offer of afternoon collections and a bank holiday opening. However, I do understand staff deserves, and should have, time off

Orchard have been looking after my dogs for a number of years and I cannot fault them. All the staff I have seen have been very caring to their patients and the pet parents too. I would not think of taking my pets anywhere else. Thank you Orchard.
Such caring,feindly staff who really care for your pet
Thank you Talha!
I have nothing but positive experience with Orchard vets, every staff member i came across in the 2.5 years were caring and helpful.

I have been with Orchard Vets for almost 5 years and they have always been nothing short of excellent. Their care, friendliness and service has been exceptional. I am very sad to be leaving them, as a change of address, to a distant location, necessitates the move. Thank you, Orchard Vets, Harborne.
We had our family dog put down today. The vet was especially kind and respectful. The staff were really understanding and helpful.thank you from the walker family x

I went to Orchard as it was recommended by family we have had another dog on there pet plan for the entirety of their life. I was initially happy however after using them for 6 months realised that they are not what they used to be! Unclear information, disorganised, and quick to shirk any responsibility on errors or mistakes. I was advised wrong on pet plan costs and cover multiple times. If they cant get the basics of customer care right, then certainly wouldn't trust them with my dog!
